inspiration: Vehicle breakdown is a hazard with memory: each miss adds 1 to a hidden chance, a 1-in-25 bonus roll adds 25 more, and a hit resets it (src/vehicle.cpp:1350-1366). Use a pity counter so miss streaks end, for parry, crit or dodge in fast duels.

The failure is telegraphed by a state before it lands: a 'about to fail' state, then a 'failed' state, then a countdown (src/vehicle.cpp:1378-1388). A readable warning before the hard effect suits a 375 px fight camera.

A quality stat is turned into a lookup table: reliability shifted down by 10 bits indexes a 64-entry chance table (src/vehicle.cpp:1305 and 1363). Cheap to tune and easy for a designer to read as a curve.

Fatigue drains on every check, not only while moving (src/vehicle.cpp:1331-1333), with one exemption state for loading (src/vehicle.cpp:1328-1329). The design idea is the exemption: a safe spot where stamina does not drain.

A reset point buys a grace period: leaving the depot refills reliability and divides the breakdown chance by four (src/vehicle.cpp:196-200). Good model for a respawn or shrine with a short protection window.
Gear is gated by a time window in each data row (src/table/engines.h:26 macro, example row src/table/engines.h:103). Our version: gear unlocked by zone or progression stage instead of the calendar.
The string set is a flat table of about 4800 keys with a prefix per system (src/lang/english.txt:534 for the news block). Keeps HUD and log text out of logic code.

briefs.label: stall-warning failure
briefs.why: A hit is announced by a short 'about to fail' state before the real effect, so the player can read it. Silhouette-level read at 375 px: a single pulsing mark on the creature's joint, not a full effect.
keep: two-step telegraph (warn state, then hard state)
one signature cue that starts the warning
warning length set by data, not code
change: warning is a colour pulse on a joint, not smoke
warning length per attack, not per creature
a different cue sound so it does not copy any donor sound

briefs.label: pity hazard roll
briefs.why: Each miss raises the chance, a rare bonus roll adds more, and a hit resets it. Streaks of misses end, which players feel as fairness. Only the shape is kept.
keep: rare bonus roll on top of the normal roll
reset to zero on a hit
change: per-fighter counter for crit or dodge, not per vehicle
different step sizes and a cap per fight
lookup curve from our own stat, not the donor table

briefs.label: rest-exempt fatigue
briefs.why: Fatigue drains on every check, but one state is exempt, so a safe action resets the pressure. The exemption is the feel: a planned pause in a fight.
keep: always-on drain with a rest exemption
exemption tied to one clear action
drain applied in one place per check
change: exemption while guarding or on a shrine, not while loading
drain per hit taken, not per tick
stamina bar colour ramp of our own

briefs.label: depot grace on respawn
briefs.why: Leaving the depot restores the stat and cuts the risk for a short period, so a fresh start is not punished at once. Good for respawn rules.
keep: risk cut to a quarter on exit
comment states the reason in code
change: restore on a shrine, with a short protection window
protection ends on the first attack, not a timer
no shared numbers with the donor

briefs.label: era-gated gear rows
briefs.why: Each gear row has its own introduction date and window, so the set of items changes over the game. Shows how data rows can carry availability as well as stats.
keep: availability window in the data row
stats and availability in one table
change: window keyed to zone or progression stage, not calendar years
no donor names or stat values
tables in our own catalogue format
